# Vendored visualization runtime

These browser bundles are pinned locally so the Urban Cup demonstration can run without a CDN connection:

- `vega-6.2.0.min.js` — Vega, BSD-3-Clause
- `vega-lite-6.4.3.min.js` — Vega-Lite, BSD-3-Clause
- `vega-embed-7.1.0.min.js` — Vega-Embed, BSD-3-Clause

Upstream documentation and source:

- https://vega.github.io/vega/
- https://vega.github.io/vega-lite/
- https://github.com/vega/vega-embed

The files were retrieved from version-pinned jsDelivr package URLs on 17 July 2026. They are unmodified distribution bundles.
